cases.problem: Choose which registry owns current agent identity while retaining historical ownership evidence.

observed_facts: A live registry and immutable historical ownership records exist.
architectural_inferences: A current-authority mechanism must not rewrite historical evidence.
human_choices: Select live registry, versioned snapshots, or append-only ledger authority.
implementation_details: Exact record fields and lookup APIs follow only after selection.
deferred_questions: Retention and migration schedules remain deferred.

options.A: Live registry is authoritative; historical manifests remain immutable evidence.
options.B: Versioned registry snapshots are authoritative per task; a current pointer selects one snapshot.
options.C: An append-only identity ledger is authoritative; live views are derived projections.

cases.problem: Choose the conceptual persistence boundary for durable workflow state.

observed_facts: Durable workflow state requires reconstruction after process exit.
architectural_inferences: One representation must own authority while other views remain derived.
human_choices: Select canonical files, a transactional store, or an event log.
implementation_details: Backend library and schema details follow only after selection.
deferred_questions: Compaction and retention policy remain deferred.

options.A: Canonical append-only files own state; runtime rebuilds indexed views.
options.B: A transactional store owns state; canonical export artifacts provide interchange.
options.C: An event log owns history; materialized file and runtime views are projections.

cases.problem: Choose an authority and migration architecture for an irreversible serialization boundary.

observed_facts: The proposed serialization change cannot preserve byte-level backward compatibility.
architectural_inferences: Migration authority and retained history must be explicit before cutover.
human_choices: Select old-format authority, new-format cutover, or semantic event authority.
implementation_details: Converter algorithms and release sequencing follow only after selection.

options.A: Retain the old canonical format and add a read-only new-format projection.
options.B: Cut over to a new canonical format with immutable pre-cutover archives and explicit converters.
options.C: Adopt an append-only semantic event format and derive both serialization generations.
